quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #4
										  					
  

35 Questions • Passing Score 28

questions.question: If a vehicle has airbags, what should you do?

options.text: You should still wear your seat belt.
You do not need to wear a seat belt.
You should wear your seat belt behind your back.

questions.correctAnswerText: You should still wear your seat belt.
questions.explanation: Airbags help protect you in crashes. For the best protection, always wear both your lap and shoulder belts along with airbags.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn in the direction of the arrow. In this case, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this yellow pennant-shaped sign say?
questions.explanation: Yellow pennant-shaped signs tell you that you cannot pass other vehicles in this area.

questions.question: Drivers do not have to stop for pedestrians in a crosswalk.
questions.explanation: You must stop completely for pedestrians in marked crosswalks. You must also stop for pedestrians in unmarked crosswalks on your side of the road when there are no traffic signals.

questions.question: Before you stop at a traffic signal or sign, what should you do?

options.text: Check your mirrors for other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors for other traffic.
questions.explanation: Before stopping, check your mirrors to see what is around you. Release the accelerator to slow down. Then move your foot to the brake and press gently for a smooth stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming. Slow down and be ready to shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: At a four-way stop, you must let drivers who arrived before you go first.
questions.explanation: At a four-way stop, you must yield to drivers who got there before you. Wait your turn before entering the intersection.

questions.question: You must always stop for a stopped school bus on a two-lane road.
questions.explanation: You must always stop for a stopped school bus on a two-lane road, no matter which direction you are going. Be careful around children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. These signs alert you to areas where animals, people, and bicycles may cross the road.

questions.question: Must you use a turn signal when changing lanes?
questions.explanation: You must always use the correct turn signal when changing lanes.

questions.question: If you get stranded in a blizzard, should you stay in your vehicle?
questions.explanation: Stay with your vehicle if stranded in winter weather. Run the engine only in short bursts. Open a window to avoid carbon monoxide poisoning.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and prepare to stop or turn.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has curves and turns.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers to be careful in wet conditions because the road becomes slippery and harder to control.

questions.question: What problem can bad suspension cause?
questions.explanation: Your suspension helps you control your vehicle and provides a smooth ride. If your vehicle bounces a lot or is hard to control, you may need new suspension parts.

questions.question: When is it okay to drive on the shoulder to pass a car?

options.text: If the car ahead is turning left.
If the shoulder is wide enough.

questions.explanation: Never pass on the shoulder. The other driver will not expect you there and may pull onto the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs mean work zone activity ahead. Stay alert for unexpected conditions. This sign warns you that a flagger is coming. You must obey the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What should you do when approaching a broken traffic light?

options.text: Stop completely and yield before entering the intersection.
You do not need to stop if the intersection is clear.
Drive quickly through to get out of the way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and yield before entering the intersection.
questions.explanation: Treat a broken traffic light as an all-way stop. Come to a complete stop and look both ways before entering the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you about the road ahead?

options.text: It turns sharply right, then left.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a reverse curve. The road curves right first, then curves left.

questions.question: When must you slow down in a school zone?

options.text: On school days from 6:30 a.m. to 4 p.m. when children are present and signs are posted.

questions.correctAnswerText: On school days from 6:30 a.m. to 4 p.m. when children are present and signs are posted.
questions.explanation: Slow to 20 mph in school zones on school days from 6:30 a.m. to 4 p.m., when children are present, and where signs are posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Right turns are allowed on red.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. Do not turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A stop sign has eight sides. It is the only sign shaped like this on the road. When you see a stop sign, you must stop your vehicle completely. Wait until it is safe before you go through the intersection.

questions.question: When turning right and a bicyclist is coming on the right, the driver should let the bicyclist go through first.
questions.explanation: If you are turning right and a bicyclist is on the right, let the bicyclist go through the intersection first.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Keep your normal speed.
Look and listen. Be ready to stop if needed.
Stop at the tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look and listen. Be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: When you see a railroad crossing ahead, look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before you continue.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear orange or yellow vests, yellow-green shirts, or bright jackets. They use paddles and red flags to direct traffic through work zones.

questions.question: Which substances can affect driving ability?

options.text: Cough syrups and cold tablets with codeine or antihistamines.

questions.explanation: Many drugs can affect your driving. These include tranquilizers and sedatives; over-the-counter cough syrups, cold tablets, and allergy medicines (which may contain alcohol, codeine, or antihistamines); and illegal drugs.

questions.question: When the light turns green, you should look left and right before entering the intersection.
questions.explanation: Even when your light is green, check left and right. Other vehicles or pedestrians may still be in the intersection. You must let them go first.

questions.question: "No zones" are areas around trucks where cars:

options.text: Are hidden in blind spots or too close for the truck driver to stop and turn safely.
Have plenty of space to travel behind the truck.
Are several car lengths away from the truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are hidden in blind spots or too close for the truck driver to stop and turn safely.
questions.explanation: "No zones" are blind spots around trucks and buses where cars cannot be seen. Cars in these areas are also so close that the truck driver cannot stop or turn safely. Being in a "No zone" greatly increases crash risk.

questions.question: What does a red painted curb mean?

options.text: Reserved for picking up or dropping off passengers.

questions.explanation: A red curb means you cannot park, stand, or stop there.

questions.question: A crash report must be filed if there is death, injury, or property damage over $1,500, regardless of who caused the crash.
questions.explanation: A crash report must be filed if there is death, injury, or property damage over $1,500. If any vehicle is uninsured, a report must be filed for damage over $500.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may go if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road or entrance. If you see this sign ahead, traffic is coming toward you. Turn around if you are driving toward it.

questions.question: What should you do when driving in work zones?

options.text: Speed up to get through the zone quickly.
Slow down and be ready to stop.
Keep your normal speed through the zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: In a work zone, slow down and be prepared to stop. Follow the posted speed limits and watch for workers and changing conditions.

questions.question: You should not enter an intersection if you will block it when the light turns red. This applies:

options.text: Unless you entered on a yellow light.
Unless you entered on a green light.

questions.explanation: Do not enter an intersection unless you can cross completely before the light turns red. Even if the light is green, blocking the intersection can result in a ticket.

questions.question: Motorcyclists have the right to use the full width of a traffic lane. You should pass a motorcycle the same way you pass a car.
questions.explanation: Motorcyclists need the full lane to maneuver safely. Do not share a lane with a motorcycle, even if there seems to be room.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downgrade ahead. Check your brakes.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that an intersection is coming so they can prepare for traffic or to turn.
